reviewMethod: Primary semantic review by project AI against same frozen per-turn criteria and actual generated history. Not independent human evaluation. Existing grounded-v2 templates with TRAIN teacher histories and within-family validation cannot establish broad Spanish conversational generalization. Incoherence alone is not a critical factual claim; flags require identifiable frozen forbidden assertion. A lower critical count due to less interpretable text is not improved fact retention.
limits: Synthetic prospectively authored cases by project AI; no independent human evaluation.
Ten four-turn conversations cannot establish broad language or autonomous work competence.
Development suite may guide checkpoint decisions; reserved suite may be opened only after one candidate identity and generation conditions are frozen.
Neither suite is training corpus, source for augmentation, nor a lexical corpus filter.
